title: Safety instrumented function
goal: Show a sensor, logic-solver, and final-element safety function with 1oo2 and 2oo3 redundancy.

rubric.must: Sensor, logic-solver, and shutdown-valve stages are visibly arranged in series.
Two high-pressure sensors are visibly arranged as a parallel 1oo2 stage.
Three logic solvers visibly enter a group labelled 2/3.
Two shutdown valves are visibly arranged as a parallel final-element stage.
Every sensor, solver, and valve block visibly displays a reliability.
A system reliability or computed analysis summary is visible on the drawing.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: Image 1 satisfies all six rules, while image 2 omits component reliabilities and explicit high-pressure sensor and shutdown-valve identities.
